bio:
Phantasy w/Negroyokio

*Monthly*

Born and raised in Columbus Ohio, Negroyokio is a DJ and producer who illustrates the glamour and grit of the midwest melting pot. Drawing references from the world, they pull sonic inspiration through the realities of the Black queer experience. All while giving ode to the ones who have come before; the dance legends, the ancestors, and down the line, what is to come beyond our lifetimes. While focusing on the styles of Techno, Club, and other Black diasporic genres, they let the music speak for itself. Giving you the right to explore the instinctual urge to move your body and find your strength in the sound.
title: Negroyokio
